items.title: BTSジン「GUCCI」で検索世界一に
items.summary: BTS's Jin took the number-one spot globally on Google Trends for Gucci's 'FACE OF GUCCI'/Primavera campaign, ahead of fellow campaign faces Kate Moss, Johan Renck, Shawn Mendes and Tom Brady. Gucci featured Jin prominently on its official homepage and in large-scale global out-of-home ads; the campaign jacket he wore reportedly sold out within 24 hours.

items.title: 'Sold-out King' BTS Jin: Gucci Campaign Jacket to Chicago Concert Merch, Sold Out Again
items.summary: Following Jin's August 28 Chicago 'ARIRANG' tour stop, coverage ties his concert-merch sellouts to the Gucci Primavera campaign jacket that sold out within 24 hours; notes Jin topped global Google Trends for Gucci-related searches, beating Kate Moss and Shawn Mendes, and trended on X across multiple countries.

items.title: theqoo: BTS Jin x Gucci Primavera campaign photoshoot reactions
items.summary: Korean community thread on Jin's Primavera photoshoot shows split reactions: several commenters criticized the makeup as 'kinda bad,' others found the smokey-eye look nostalgic of BTS's debut era, and some praised Jin for trying an experimental new concept. Reflects genuine fan-community ambivalence rather than uniform praise.

items.title: 金硕珍粉丝非法曝光肖战身份证信息，工作室已起诉
items.summary: Some Jin (BTS) fans were angered that actor Xiao Zhan received the WWD magazine cover placement in Gucci's FW26 campaign while Jin appeared only on an inside page; a subset of fans then illegally posted Xiao Zhan's ID card details on Xiaohongshu, prompting Xiao Zhan's studio to file suit Aug 27 via Zhejiang Lingyun Xihe law firm seeking platform disclosure of the users' identities. Jin's fan account statement supporting legal action drew criticism for lacking a direct apology.

items.title: 金硕珍与肖战 Gucci 待遇对比投票
items.summary: Weibo-driven comparison/vote threads on perceived unequal ad placement between Jin and Xiao Zhan in Gucci's campaign escalated into cross-fandom disputes; aggregation of multiple Weibo hot-topic threads discussing 'overseas influence' comparisons between the two ambassadors amid the doxxing controversy.

items.source: Yicai (第一财经) via search aggregation
items.title: 开云Q2止跌回暖，古驰修复仍要看中国
items.summary: Kering's H1 2026 results showed Q2 group comparable revenue growth of 2% (first positive quarter in three years) to EUR3.652bn, but net profit fell 60% YoY to EUR189m. Gucci's Q2 comparable sales decline narrowed to 2% (from a steeper prior pace) but Asia-Pacific sales still fell 10%; management cited domestic Chinese 'luxury fatigue' and said full recovery needs 12-24 months. Kering closed 84 stores in H1 toward a 100-store annual closure target.

items.title: 中共税收冲击下 中国奢侈品销售大幅下滑
items.summary: Reports that China's top 25 luxury brands saw sales drop over 10% in July, reversing earlier momentum, as Beijing's crackdown on offshore wealth and back-tax enforcement on foreign assets combined with an 8.9% YTD MSCI China decline to curb affluent spending. Gucci is named among brands posting double-digit sales declines; a Shanghai finance professional interviewee describes abandoning non-essential luxury purchases after large portfolio losses.

items.title: グッチが新作バッグ「ジャッキー フラップ」発売
items.summary: Gucci launched the 'Jackie Flap' bag, a men's-facing two-way shoulder/crossbody piece derived from the archival Jackie silhouette with the signature piston closure, offered in GG canvas (JPY473,000) and leather (JPY539,000) as part of the Primavera collection rollout in Japan.

items.title: グッチ新作「ジャッキー フラップ」セレブリティ愛用SNAP
items.summary: Roundup of Instagram/SNS snaps showing celebrities and vintage-Gucci-focused influencers (including tennis player Oda Kintaro) adopting the new Jackie Flap bag, framed as reviving interest in the archival Jackie line among younger audiences.
